description: Combine brief-42 dense-cluster routing (586352251, geomean 33175: shape11 lapdense_even 208 to 129ms via _eigh_clust_full + PR/twolevel gate) with brief-44 FP32-accurate 3xTF32 dominant-Gram on the low-rank path (d6ce9b524, ~34015: shapes 8/10/6/4/12 via _lr_dom_gram_mode_for + _gram_3xtf32_sym + _MIXED_PEEL_DOM_GRAM_MODE). Genuine siblings off f8e44f9d1, disjoint shapes and disjoint functions; graft brief-44 low-rank precision router onto the brief-42 base. Est ~32870 = new best.

t1 COMBINE: applied brief-44 net diff (f8e44f9d1..d6ce9b524, +128/-25) onto PARENT A base 586352251 via git apply --recount -> PURE UNION (combined vs ancestor = +275/-25 = A+B; disjoint functions, no manual merge needed). custom_kernel dispatch: low-rank route now carries dom_gram_mode=_lr_dom_gram_mode_for(n,k_lr) (B; shapes 8/10/6/4/12) AND A's _CLUST_FULL block routes dense n=512 flat-spectrum to _eigh_clust_full (shape 11); B modifies the low-rank RETURN which sits BEFORE A's added block so NO collision. Shape3 (dense512 cond2 k=352) stays FP32 (_lr_dom_gram_mode_for: 352<384). _gram_3xtf32_sym FP32-accurate 2-bmm preserved; _MIXED_PEEL_DOM_GRAM_MODE=3xtf32. geomean 32875.308us vs PARENT A 33175.072 (-0.9%) -- ADDITIVE. 39/39 pass. 'stream' ABSENT. shape11 profile: mega_eigh_clust_split_k 81.5%.

t2 EXTEND (regresses): route the dominant power-step CQR2 back-solve Q=Q@L^-T through TRSM-as-GEMM (k*k FP32 inverse + 3xTF32 TC-GEMM on the B*n*k RHS) via _cqr2_trsm + _lr_dom_trsm_mode_for (mirrors gram router) + _MIXED_PEEL_DOM_TRSM_MODE=3xtf32, threaded per-pass through _lr_cholesky_qr2/_lowrank_eigh/_eigh_lowrank_safe/mixed-peel. geomean 33165 vs t1 32875 (+0.9% REGRESSION). Low-rank shapes worse: shape6 +5.3% (126528->133243), shape8 +4.2% (91432->95274), shape4 +2.0%, shape10 +1.9%; shape11/shape3 unchanged. shape8 nsys DIAGNOSIS: cuSOLVER fallback kernels PRESENT (sytrd4_gpu 3.8ms + potrf_syrk/potrfBatch_trsm/potrf_cta_lower) => the explicit L^-T inverse of the ill-conditioned Cholesky factor tips rankdef matrices over the orth gate (fallback double-solve); AND the added k*k FP32 inverse solve (batch_trsm_left_kernel 11.7ms/12.7%) is itself not free at B=640. 39/39 pass (gate protects). Next: pass-2-only 3xTF32 trsm (CQR2 self-corrects conditioning after pass1).

t4 EXTEND (regresses): restrict pass-2 3xTF32 trsm to n>=1024 only (shapes 4/10/12); FP32 on all n=512 (mixed peel reverted to fp32, _lr_dom_trsm_mode_for returns fp32 for n<1024). Restoring FP32 on n=512 recovered shape6 (126014~t1) and shape8 (91444~t1). geomean 32912 vs t1 32875 (+0.1%, still regression). The n>=1024 trsm 3xTF32 itself slightly regresses: shape4 +0.8%, shape10 +1.1%, shape12 +0.2% -- Ozaki split overhead on the B*n*k RHS + the added k*k FP32 inverse solve >= the pass-2 trsm saving even at n=1024. 39/39 pass. CONCLUSION across t2/t3/t4: the explicit-inverse TRSM-as-GEMM does NOT beat the clean combine on any subset tested (whole-solve, pass-2-only, n>=1024-only). t1 (32875, additive combine) is the brief's deliverable. Openings not yet tried: (a) a fused custom trsm-as-GEMM kernel avoiding the separate batch_trsm_left inverse solve; (b) BF16x9/bf16x3 emulated-FP32 trsm; (c) larger-k routing so the RHS dominates the fixed inverse cost.

t5 FINAL clean additive combine (branch HEAD): removed the dead TRSM-as-GEMM machinery, restored the t1 union. brief-42 dense-cluster (A) + brief-44 low-rank 3xTF32 dominant-Gram (B), pure union of disjoint functions/shapes. Re-measured geomean 32892us (==t1 32875 within noise), 39/39 pass, 'stream' absent. Both wins SIMULTANEOUSLY present vs PARENT A (direct-measured 33218): shape11 lapdense_even 130103 (A cluster, mega_eigh_clust_split_k 81.5% in t1 profile) + shapes 4/6/8/10/12 at B's 3xTF32 values (4:-2.9%, 6:-4.8%, 8:-2.0%, 10:-2.2%, 12:-1.4%); shape3 protected FP32 (flat). ADDITIVE, not interacting: A's shape11 win and B's shapes-4/6/8/10/12 wins are both fully present at once. New global best below PARENT A 33175. shape10 final profile: mega_eigh_clust_split_k 59.1% + batch_trsm_left_kernel 5.4% + residual sytrd4_gpu fallback ~8ms => the trsm and the remaining cuSOLVER fallback are still open levers for future briefs (but the explicit-inverse trsm-as-GEMM refuted here).

COMBINE brief-42 (PARENT A dense-cluster) + brief-44 (PARENT B low-rank 3xTF32) LANDED as a PURE ADDITIVE UNION. Branch HEAD b73639eae, geomean 32892us (re-measured; == t1's 32875 within noise) -- NEW GLOBAL BEST below PARENT A's 33175. 39/39 validated, 'stream' absent. HEAD combined diff vs ancestor f8e44f9d1 = +275/-25 = exactly A(+147) + B(+128/-25); B's net diff git-apply'd onto A with ZERO manual merge (disjoint functions), the custom_kernel tail needed no hand-merge because B modifies the low-rank RETURN which sits BEFORE A's added _CLUST_FULL block. BOTH wins simultaneously present, measured against a direct PARENT-A benchmark (33218): shape11 lapdense_even 130103 (A cluster, mega_eigh_clust_split_k 81.5%) UNCHANGED + shapes 4/6/8/10/12 all at B's improved 3xTF32 values (4:-2.9%, 6:-4.8%, 8:-2.0%, 10:-2.2%, 12:-1.4% vs A); shape3 (protected FP32) flat. The two wins are ADDITIVE, NOT interacting -- disjoint shapes, both fully present at once. TRSM-EXTENSION (brief's optional stretch, t2-t4): extended 3xTF32 to the dominant CQR2 back-solve via explicit-inverse TRSM-as-GEMM (k*k FP32 inverse + 3xTF32 GEMM on B*n*k RHS). REFUTED on every subset: whole-solve (t2 33165, +0.9%: shape8 nsys shows cuSOLVER sytrd4_gpu FALLBACK -- the ill-conditioned L^-T inverse tips matrices over the orth gate), pass-2-only (t3 33082, +0.6%), n>=1024-only (t4 32912, +0.1%). Root cause: the Ozaki split overhead on the B*n*k RHS + the ADDED k*k batch_trsm_left inverse solve >= the trsm saving, and fallback at n=512. Removed the dead machinery in t5. OPENINGS STILL OPEN for future briefs: (a) the trsm is STILL ~5.4% of shape10 and ~14.5% of shape8 in the final build -- a FUSED custom trsm-as-GEMM kernel that avoids the separate batch_trsm_left inverse solve, or a BF16x9/bf16x3 EMULATED-FP32 trsm (env.md: cuBLAS bf16x9 ~FP32-accurate at ~3x native FP32), might crack it where the torch explicit-inverse path could not; (b) residual cuSOLVER sytrd4_gpu fallback (~8ms) persists on the low-rank shapes -- a tighter orth gate or reseed could reclaim it; (c) the Vd lift + complement projections are still FP32 and untried at 3xTF32 in the COMBINED build. Recommend the manager promote b73639eae as the new global best and submit it to the leaderboard.

Combine brief-42 dense-cluster routing (586352251, geomean 33175: shape11 lapdense_even 208 to 129ms via _eigh_clust_full + PR/twolevel gate) with brief-44 FP32-accurate 3xTF32 dominant-Gram on the low-rank path (d6ce9b524, ~34015: shapes 8/10/6/4/12 via _lr_dom_gram_mode_for + _gram_3xtf32_sym + _MIXED_PEEL_DOM_GRAM_MODE). Genuine siblings off f8e44f9d1, disjoint shapes and disjoint functions; graft brief-44 low-rank precision router onto the brief-42 base. Est ~32870 = new best.

t6 Lever-1 Vd-lift 3xTF32 in COMBINED build -> NEW BEST. Added _lr_vd_lift_mode_for (3xTF32 for n>=1024 and n=512 k>=384, FP32 zero-margin n=512 k<=352) + _MIXED_PEEL_VD_LIFT_MODE=3xtf32; wired through custom_kernel low-rank route + both mixed-peel sites. geomean 32797 vs clean-combine 32892 (-0.29%). Paid on n=1024 (shape4 -0.9%, shape10 -0.4%), neutral n=512, shape11 held. brief-44's net-neutral Vd-lift finding was parent-specific; combined build's shape balance makes it a win. 39/39 pass, no gate re-trip.

t7 Lever-1 complement-projection 3xTF32 (n>=1024) -> NEW BEST. Route R-Qd(Qd^T R) through 3xTF32 on n>=1024 via _lr_proj_mode_for + _lr_proj_out (2 chained _matmul_3xtf32); FP32 n=512; plain TF32 still banned (breaks V=[Vd,Vc] orth). geomean 32773 vs t6 32797 (-0.07%; -0.36% cumulative vs combine). Paid shape4 -1.3%, shape12 -0.8%; shape7/10 neutral, n=512 unchanged, shape11 held. 39/39 pass, no gate re-trip. Both win-sets present.

t8 Lever-2 FUSED blocked trsm-as-GEMM (p=2, n>=1024) -> REGRESSES. NOT the t2-t4 explicit-inverse form: solve L@X^T=Q^T by 2-panel forward substitution (small FP32 diagonal-panel solves + 3xTF32 coupling GEMM, no full inverse). _cqr2_trsm blk3xtf32 branch, _lr_dom_trsm_mode_for n>=1024-only. geomean 32971 vs t7 32773 (+0.6%). n=1024 worse: shape4 +3.3%, shape12 +3.0%, shape10 +1.9%. 39/39 pass (diagonal solves FP32 -> NO fallback, unlike t2). The 2 smaller trsms + 3-bmm coupling + Bt copy/alloc exceed the saving; native batch_trsm_left_kernel already well-tuned.

t9 Lever-2 blocked trsm p=4 -> worse than p=2. _CQR2_TRSM_BLOCKS=4. geomean 33079 vs p=2 32971 vs t7 32773. More panels = more small trsm dispatches + more coupling GEMMs, monotonically worse (shape4 49692->50136, shape10 104212->105277, shape12 34201->34575). 39/39 pass. CONCLUSION: fused blocked trsm-as-GEMM refuted at every block count; with t2-t4 explicit-inverse refutation, the CQR2 trsm does NOT yield to any torch-level reformulation -- native cuBLAS batch_trsm_left is efficient; only a hand-written fused CUDA kernel could crack it.

t10 Lever-3 bf16x3 dominant Gram -> CATASTROPHIC mass fallback. fp32_precision knob in torch 2.12.1+cu130 rejects bf16x3/bf16x9 (only tf32/ieee/none; cuBLAS bf16x9 NOT exposed), so hand-rolled _gram_bf16x3_sym (2 bf16 bmms, ~2x TF32 rate). geomean 42659 vs t7 32773 (+30%). Mass cuSOLVER fallback: shape4 +215%, shape8 +103%, shape12 +310%. 39/39 pass (gate falls back) but double-solve ruinous. bf16's 8 mantissa bits -> ~1.5e-5 hi+lo accuracy, NOT enough for ill-conditioned Gram (kappa 1e3-1e4) -- same plain-TF32 mass-fallback mechanism. Only 3xTF32 (~6e-6) survives.

t11 Lever-3 bf16x3 Vd lift -> also mass fallback (+39%). _matmul_bf16x3 + bf16x3 branch in _lr_lift_gemm; _lr_vd_lift_mode_for->bf16x3. Hypothesis (well-conditioned lift operands) WRONG: geomean 45642 vs t7 32773. shape8 +179%, shape10, shape4 all mass-fall-back. Qd is ill-conditioned (kappa 1e3-1e4) and Vd=Qd@G inherits it, so bf16x3 ~1.5e-5 breaks V=[Vd,Vc] orth over the gate. CONCLUSION: bf16x3 refuted EVERYWHERE on the low-rank path (Gram t10, lift t11); only FP32-accurate 3xTF32 survives -- exactly the brief's precision fact. Lever 3 fully refuted.

t12 FINAL: restore the t7 Lever-1 best as branch HEAD (Levers 2/3 dead code removed). HEAD = clean additive combine (brief-42 dense-cluster A + brief-44 low-rank 3xTF32 B) PLUS Lever-1 Vd-lift 3xTF32 (t6) + complement-projection 3xTF32 n>=1024 (t7). Re-measured geomean 32721 (== t7 32773 within noise), 39/39 pass, 'stream' absent. BOTH win-sets present: shape11 lapdense_even 130004 (A cluster, mega_eigh_clust_split_k 42.6% on shape4) + shapes 4/6/8/10/12 improved (Lever-1 added -1.3% shape4, -0.8% shape12 over the combine). CUMULATIVE brief-45 best 32721 vs clean-combine 32892 vs PARENT A 33175. shape4 final profile: mega_eigh_clust_split_k 42.6% + batch_trsm_left_kernel 12.4% (trsm STILL top outer lever, only a hand-written fused CUDA kernel could beat it -- all torch reformulations lost) + potrf cuSOLVER ~9% + 3xTF32 Gram/lift GEMMs. Levers resolved: L1 PAID (banked), L2 refuted (native trsm efficient), L3 refuted (bf16x3 mass-falls-back on ill-conditioned path).
